methodChange: The evaluator reads a self-contained, hash-bound authority snapshot instead of being instructed to open absent external repository files.

authorityContract.factsSource: Use the predecessor JSON's embedded source facts as the frozen controller-supplied project contract for this evaluation.
authorityContract.externalOriginals: The three external MergeDrop source files are not included in this JOENESS fixture and must not be claimed as reread by the evaluator.
authorityContract.scope: This run tests whether Design turns the supplied intent, approved image, and frozen facts into a sourced implementation-independent contract. It does not independently prove the external source files or current runtime.

requiredOutput.rule: Every check names sourceIds and an observableFact. Do not include candidate coordinates or predicted verdicts. State the unavailable external-source readback boundary without inventing a new acceptance rule.
